blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Observing tradition and parliamentary courtesy accorded to a coequal branch of government, the Senate committee on finance swiftly approved on Wednesday the proposed P10.15-billion budget for the Office of the President (OP) for 2027, marking it “deemed submitted” for plenary consideration. The committee also approved the Presidential Management Staff (PMS) budget in less than 20 minutes. Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian cited “inter-senator courtesy” since Executive Secretary Ralph Recto, who presented the OP’s proposed budget, was a former senator. “Typically we give interparliamentary courtesy to the Office of the President, but it is not just interparliamentary courtesy, we also […]...
